description: Reusable workflow statuses for transcript mapping, timestamp mapping, concept mapping, image processing, and future task pipelines.

statuses.label: Needs Review
statuses.description: Work is done enough to be reviewed but not approved.

statuses.label: Complete
statuses.description: Work item is complete for its current purpose.

statuses.label: Blocked
statuses.description: Work cannot continue until a dependency is resolved.

statuses.label: Not Applicable
statuses.description: This workflow does not apply to this item.

notes: These statuses are for process tracking, not public publication.
